setup.title: Set up OpensourceERP
setup.subtitle: Five steps to your first login — no k9o needed
setup.setupAlreadyDone: Setup has already been completed. You will be redirected to the login page …

server.intro: Access to the PostgreSQL server. The role needs the right to create databases (usually "postgres").
server.configFound: A k9o configuration was found — credentials are prefilled.
server.noCreatedbHint: This role cannot create new databases. Please use a role with CREATEDB or adopt existing databases.
server.stored: Credentials from the existing configuration: {user} on {host}:{port}. The password stays on the server.

auth.intro: The auth database holds users, groups and the list of companies. It is compatible with k9o — an existing one can be adopted directly.
auth.name: Name of the auth database
auth.modeExistingHint: Adopt users, groups and companies of an existing k9o installation. Missing OSERP tables are added.
auth.noneFound: No auth database was found on the server.

admin.intro: The first user becomes system administrator: may manage users, groups and companies and gets the group "Full access".
admin.introExisting: Who should be system administrator? Enter an existing login name (password is kept if left empty) or create a new one.
admin.loginHintExisting: Existing login name or a new one
admin.name: Full name
admin.passwordHint: At least 8 characters — or generate one
admin.passwordHintExisting: Leave empty to keep the existing password
admin.modeDefaultHint: Log in with {login} and the same word as the password. Ready at once, please change it afterwards.
admin.modeCustomHint: Choose name, e-mail and your own password.
admin.defaultWarning: The password is initially the same as the login name. Please change it after the first login under "Users and Companies".
admin.existingUsersHint: This installation already has users. Please sign in with an existing administrator so the wizard may continue.

company.intro: Each company gets its own database with a chart of accounts. You can add more companies at any time later.
company.name: Company name
company.dbnameHint: Suggested from the company name — lowercase letters, digits, underscore

charts.skr03: Process-oriented — the standard for most businesses
charts.skr04: Statement-oriented — common for GmbH, AG and larger companies

company.noneWarning: Without a company there is nothing to see after login. A company can be created later under "Users and Companies".

summary.intro: Please review. The installation takes about a minute.
summary.installingHint: Creating databases, loading schema and chart of accounts. Please keep this window open.
summary.loginHintDefault: Log in now as "{login}" — the password equals the login name. Please change it right away.

validation.dbname: Only lowercase letters, digits, underscore and hyphen, starting with a letter
validation.dbExists: A database with this name already exists

errors.testNetworkError: Network error while checking the connection
errors.ADMIN_LOGIN_REQUIRED: This installation already has users. Please enter the login name and password of an existing administrator.
errors.AUTH_DB_UNREACHABLE: The auth database cannot be reached with the details from the configuration.

state.no_database: The configuration points to the database "{db}", which does not exist on the server yet. The wizard will create it.
state.no_schema: The database "{db}" exists but has no tables yet. The wizard will set it up now.
state.no_user: The database "{db}" has no user yet. Without a user there is no way to log in.
state.no_client: No company has been set up yet. Without a company, logging in leads nowhere.
